about.en: Broadcom xStock (AVGOx) is a tokenized tracker certificate on Broadcom Inc. shares (AVGO), issued by Backed Assets (JE) Limited under the xStocks brand. Each token is backed by AVGO shares held with regulated custodians and tracks the share price on-chain; it is offered to eligible non-US investors and gives a claim on the issuer, not registered ownership of the shares. It is a Token-2022 mint on Solana (XsgSaSvNSqLTtFuyWPBhK9196Xb9Bbdyjj4fH3cPJGo) and an ERC-20 at 0x38BAC69cbBd28156796e4163B2B6dcb81E336565 on Ethereum, BNB Chain, Arbitrum and other EVM networks.
